purpose: Provide explicit review hypotheses connecting existing original image-source folder categories to AI4I source failure-mode labels for an UNPAIRED class reference catalog. Not ground truth, not same machine, not model training labels.

TWF.physical_evidence: Original AI4I tool wear [min] plus documented cutting-tool failure; generic component abrasion alone insufficient

HDF.physical_evidence: AI4I air/process temperature differential and rotational speed; independently diagnosed thermal system fault

PWF.physical_evidence: AI4I torque and rotational speed supply a calculated mechanical power indicator; not proof of electrical supply outage

OSF.physical_evidence: AI4I tool wear [min], torque [Nm] and original product Type; source-specific mechanical strain condition, not generic cracks

RNF.physical_evidence: Original AI4I RNF source target or documented independent event diagnosis, NOT leftover image classes

original_photo_folder_rules.justification: Visible generic component wear can suggest wear mechanisms, but is not verified as AI4I cutting tool wear failure
Visible cracks may be consistent with overload, fatigue, corrosion or other causes; no verified AI4I strain diagnosis
Misalignment can contribute to mechanical loading but is not equivalent to overstrain; some original source images show only equipment/product photos
Generic surface flaws have multiple possible mechanisms and may be unrelated to mechanical overstrain
Source-folder claim of normal visual appearance; not verified no-failure diagnosis and not RNF

note_scania: SCANIA original 105 sensor columns / 14 operational variables are anonymized: cannot claim named SCANIA temperature, torque, power, tool wear or these five AI4I failure labels
note_ai4i: Original AI4I is publisher synthetic process records, not source-proven per-machine synchronized time series. Five binary mode flags are original targets, never input features. Keep 27 disputed UDI rows quarantined.
